main.description: A joke shouted into the Void from one Place. The root of a carry-tree — Echoes and Murmurs reference it by rootUri. rkey is NOT a random TID: the reference client derives it deterministically from (author DID, text, place id, minute bucket) so that resubmitting the same compose after a dropped response is a no-op instead of a duplicate post — see notes in public/lib/voidlogic.mjs (rkeyForShout).

text.description: The joke itself. Text-only — no embeds on this lexicon.

sourcePostUri.description: Optional provenance: an existing app.bsky.feed.post this Shout was imported from via CAR import.

place.description: A point on the Void's map. id/name/emoji identify a curated Place; lat/lng are its coordinates. Any client may publish a Place outside the curated list as long as the shape validates.

lat.description: Decimal degrees, as a string — the atproto record data model has no float type, so a JS number here gets rejected by putRecord for any non-integer coordinate. Parse with Number()/parseFloat() on read.

lng.description: Decimal degrees, as a string — see lat.
